sloka: रात्रियुद्धे मया पूर्वं वज्राशनिसमैः शरैः।शायितौ स्थो मया भूमौ विसञ्ज्ञौ सपुरस्सरौ ।। ६.८८.१० ।।
transliteration: rātriyuddhe mayā pūrvaṁ vajrāśanisamaiḥ śaraiḥ।śāyitau stho mayā bhūmau visañjñau sapurassarau ।। 6.88.10 ।।

translations.english: "Earlier in the war at night, by the thunderbolt like arrows released by me on the Earth, you and your accomplice were made unconscious and laid low."
